item.title: Apple Cider Vinegar Keto Detox Drink - The Health Finds
item.description: Apple Cider Vinegar is made by microbes like bacteria and yeast that turn sugars in the apple juice to Alcohol and then to Vinegar (Acetic Acid). Apple cider Vinegar has tons of benefits for your gastrointestinal tract. Paired up with some other ingredients, makes it the perfect detox drink.

item.title: 90-seconds Dairy-Free Keto Bread - The Health Finds
item.description: 90 second Keto breads have become very popular lately but it’s really extremely challenging to find the right recipe and get it right. This is an uncomplicated and super simple recipe that is effortless and makes quick Dairy-free Keto Bread that uses almond flour and is also low carb.

item.title: Lamb Shank and Rice - Mediterranean Mandi Recipe - The Health Finds
item.description: Lamb Shank and Rice is a popular Mediterranean dish that has an extraordinary savor because of its rich spice blend characteristic to the Middle East. The Lamb Shank is slow-cooked with the spices for the flawlessly tender bites and intense aroma of it all is just to die for. The rice of the Lamb Shank and Rice recipe is cooked in the same broth that comes out like wisps of feather, almost ethereal.

item.title: Low-Carb Chicken Fajitas - The Health Finds
item.description: Low-carb Chicken Fajitas are a treat when you’re looking for Mexican food. Just leave out the tortilla and you’re good to go. This low-carb chicken fajitas paired with some fresh, green salad is the wholesome meal you’ve been missing out on. Packed with spicy seasoning and tangy flavors, this low-carb chicken fajita recipe is to die for.

item.title: Keto Lemon Salmon Recipe - The Health Finds
item.description: When you’re on a keto diet, you have to include healthy fats in your meals. This Keto Lemon Salmon is one of the most nutritious foods you can have. Layered in multitude of spices and olive oil with lemon squeezed on top, this healthy Keto Lemon Salmon recipe is undeniably flawless.

item.title: Keto Chicken Nuggets - The Health Finds
item.description: Keto Chicken Nuggets is a healthy, wholesome and nutritive, not to mention overwhelmingly delicious. You can make this even for kids and they are going to devour it, no doubt there. This Keto Chicken Nuggets is appropriate for all ages and also for any events as appetisers.

item.title: Mediterranean Chicken and Rice - The Health Finds
item.description: Mediterranean Chicken and Rice is a recipe of Chicken marinated in a unique blend of Spices that give the chicken it’s distinctive Mediterranean flavor. Spicy Onions and a tomato salad on the side brings everything together splendidly. This Mediterranean Chicken and Rice would be incomplete with the famous Hummus or the white sauce.

item.title: Keto Avocado Toast - The Health Finds
item.description: Keto Avocado Toast is a rich and creamy Avocado spread onto a slice of Bread that is toasted in ghee for the perfect crisp and topped with Eggs that have firm whites and gooey yolks, garnished with Red Chilli Flakes for the ultimate kick. This Keto Avocado Toast is healthy, delicious and the easiest toast recipe there is.

item.title: Whole Wheat Bagels - The Health Finds
item.description: Whole Wheat Bagels are tough and glossy on the outside and pliable soft when you tear into it. These Whole Wheat Bagels are deliciously irresistible and super versatile for crazy rushed mornings or lazy late afternoons, for quick healthy breakfast or to go with your morning coffee. Just slice and have infinite combinations between the two!

item.title: Keto Spinach and Cottage Cheese Curry - The Health Finds
item.description: Palak Paneer- Spinach and Cottage Cheese Curry is an easy and healthy recipe that involves, well, Spinach (Palak in Hindi) and Indian Cottage Cheese (Paneer). You already know Spinach is a great source of Iron and many other minerals. Cottage Cheese is this delicious, wholesome ingredient that takes the recipe to a whole new level. Paired with some Keto Garlic Naan, this Palak Paneer (Spinach and Cottage Cheese Curry) is to die for, literally!
